files.description: Each file of the version, by its path under `version_dir`, and its SHA-256.

images.description: Every image it runs, pinned: its own and its companions'.

version.description:
The image's tag, `~hlbN` after it for the Nth packaging of that tag: a fix to
the manifest or the guide alone is an update too.

Revoked.description: A version withdrawn from a source, and why.

why.description: Said to whoever runs it: what is wrong, and what to do.

counter.description: Rises with every index signed: lower than the highest one seen is a replay.

expires.description:
Unix seconds. Past it, nothing new is installed from the source; what runs
keeps running.

revoked.description:
The versions withdrawn, by app: never installed or upgraded to again, and named
on every house running one. Signed with the rest, so a mirror cannot hide a
revocation longer than it can hide the index — and never taken back: a version
revoked by mistake is followed by a new one.

source.description:
The source this index is for: an index signed for another one is refused, even
under the same key.
